name: crashpad
description: Crashpad is a library for capturing, storing and transmitting postmortem crash reports from a client to an upstream collection server. Crashpad aims to make it possible for clients to capture process state at the time of crash with the best possible fidelity and coverage, with the minimum of fuss.

Globulation 2 overlay: Linux builds use Crashpad's socket HTTP transport without TLS, so Crashpad links neither libcurl nor its own OpenSSL; the game never uploads through Crashpad (docs/multiplayer/crash-reports.md).
